mask_description_correction: Frozen config says dilated 33 pixels. Actual code uses MaxFilter(33): a 33x33 maximum-filter window, about 16 pixels outward per side. Frozen source/config is preserved unchanged.

pipeline_audit.observed_code: Lines 1179-1185 encode both C*(1-M) and C*M. A white mask does not erase the RGB control. TTM false skips its latent-copy path; raw is VAE-decoded at lines 502-509 before external compositing.
pipeline_audit.interpretation: Photo conversion failed under this setting; over-retention of control appearance is plausible but is not uniquely diagnosed. No direct control-frame copy-back to raw was found.

limits: Two development inputs and one seed do not establish generalization or statistical superiority.
Similarity is oracle-assisted from target 3D projected landmarks, not an independently depth-free method and not every possible 2D baseline.
All arms share the phase trajectory; smoothness alone is not a 3D contribution.
Fixed face ordering, final fork-tine redraw and fixed pixel-width utensils do not implement full dynamic visibility.
Zero control-space error for 3D is true by construction, not a generated-output success metric.
No Qwen appearance repair or additional encoder/LoRA training was performed in this batch.
